Description.SourceString:
Observation log: My assessment of the area has changed the longer we have been here, Sir. At first, the area seemed perfect for setting up base. The expedition seems to avoid the place, there were plenty of opportunities to be hidden from sight, and Agent Orecchiette made friends with a strange creature that would be an ideal guard demon. The area was so humid that it almost felt like being underwater.

That assessment has changed, though, Sir. It reflects our worst instincts. 

I was whispering to a comrade about a potential mole in the group. We thought we were alone, but another whisper joined ours. It suggested that the mole was Agent Capellini: someone I can vouch for, Sir. We searched the immediate vicinity for another penguin, but there was none. I know penguins are masters of camouflage, but if anyone would have been able to flush out an interloper, it would be me. 

I am in no doubt that the swamp whispers back, Sir. Our paranoia is doubled and throubled by our surroundings. If we stay here, I have no doubt that we would strangle each other with our thighs until there was only one of us left. Thighlander, if you will. 

Threat assessment: Extreme - There is no bigger threat than our own kind.

End of report.

- Agent Ravioli
